name: Swipies Agent Access
description: External AI clients manage tenant resources through MCP and authenticated APIs. Swipies does not host the external assistant.

bootstrap.reconnect: Reuse the same locally persisted secret; do not register a new account per request.
bootstrap.client_requirements: Authorized HTTPS POST and private durable storage; no preconfigured MCP connector is required.

operations.operation_ids: Discover at runtime; never guess or hardcode them.

boundaries: Use existing authorized HTTPS/code tools directly; host MCP installation is optional for this path. A documentation URL cannot add tools to a webpage-reading-only session.
Existing customers must use their existing account API key to access that tenant and subscription.
Private databases, providers and OAuth services require valid authorized credentials.
Admin operations, payments, token management and Ads are not exposed by the current generic MCP catalog.
Client permissions, account authorization, subscription quotas and registration rate limits remain in force.
After an ambiguous write timeout, inspect state before retrying.

preferred_access.requires: Authorized HTTPS request tools or code with network access and private durable credential storage.
preferred_access.account_selection: Reuse authorized existing-account credentials for existing resources; bootstrap only a new separate Free workspace.
preferred_access.no_api_tools: A webpage URL cannot install tools or grant account access in the AI host.

scope: new isolated Free registration without preconfigured MCP or key
direct_https_verification.client_environment: Python code making ordinary HTTPS requests; no host MCP installation used
